identity.name: Overseas
identity.one_liner: The first-generation Overseas (1996) brought back as the Overseas II in 2016 with the in-house 5100 caliber. The third member of the steel-sport-trinity that the 5711 made collectible.

narrative.story: The Overseas is the oldest of the three "trinity" steel sport watches, predating the Royal Oak (1972) by 4 years and the Nautilus (1976) by 4. The first Overseas (1996) was designed by Jörg Hysek; the second-generation (2016) was redesigned by Vincent Kaufmann and is built on the in-house 5100 caliber. The 4500V (blue dial) and 4600E (rose-gold) and 44018 (steel three-hand) round out the family. The Overseas is the underdog of the steel-sport-trinity: less hype than the Nautilus, less marketing than the Royal Oak, and on a value basis the strongest of the three.
